author: hlntnr
text:
+1 to this thread & linked piece re: diffusion rule.

It's not just a question of leaking tech to adversaries—if compute will be a major source of national power over the next 10-20 years, then letting the Gulf amass giant concentrations of leading-node chips is a bad plan.
